name: Cumberland County, NC
findings: Cumberland County has 932 nonprofit organizations. 314 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 247 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cumberland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few education organizations list public events
observations.text: 6 education organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 18 would.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through education groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Cumberland County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 182 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list public events
observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 16 would.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 137 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 137 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
